title: Daytime vs Hybrid — Which Solar System Should You Choose?
author: Syed Solar Energy
excerpt: Understand the difference between daytime and hybrid systems so you buy once—and buy right.
content:
## Key differences
- **Daytime**: direct solar usage, no batteries.
- **Hybrid**: includes batteries + grid backup.

### When to choose hybrid
If you face frequent outages or want night-time backup, hybrid is ideal.
